patterns_identified.description: Managed database services cost approximately 10x more than self-hosted alternatives at scale
patterns_identified.evidence: MongoDB Atlas: $3000/month vs Hetzner self-managed: $300/month (90% reduction)
patterns_identified.threshold: Cost-effective under $500/month or without dedicated DevOps expertise
patterns_identified.recommendation: Monitor Firestore costs monthly. Plan migration to Cloud SQL if costs exceed $500/month. Don't optimize prematurely.

patterns_identified.description: Cross-cloud and cross-region data transfer costs can equal or exceed infrastructure costs
patterns_identified.evidence: Prosopo: AWS data transfer = $1000/month (same as database server costs)
patterns_identified.recommendation: Keep agents and data in same region (us-west1). Monitor GCP egress costs monthly. Use Pub/Sub for async communication instead of HTTP.
mitigation_strategies: VPC connector for Cloud Run to Firestore communication

patterns_identified.description: Feed malicious bots infinite fake data instead of blocking, flipping cost asymmetry
patterns_identified.technique: Markov chain text generation creates realistic-looking but meaningless content
patterns_identified.effectiveness: High for dumb scrapers, Medium for sophisticated bots
patterns_identified.resource_economics: Attacker wastes bandwidth downloading junk, defender uses minimal CPU
patterns_identified.recommendation: Low priority. API rate limiting sufficient for current scale. Revisit if public endpoints receive heavy bot traffic.

patterns_identified.description: Multi-cloud works for stateless compute but fails for stateful databases due to data transfer costs
patterns_identified.lesson: Resilience strategy backfired: different cloud providers = expensive cross-provider traffic
patterns_identified.best_practice: Single cloud for data layer, multi-cloud for compute layer acceptable
patterns_identified.recommendation: Current single-cloud (GCP) architecture is correct. GitHub Actions runners provide 'free' multi-cloud compute. Don't overcomplicate with multi-cloud database.

patterns_identified.description: Teams taking databases back in-house for 10x cost savings, enabled by Kubernetes and automation maturity

pros: Full control over tuning and configuration

patterns_identified.recommendation: Not applicable at current scale. Firestore ($10-20/month) is right choice. Revisit if costs exceed $500/month.
patterns_identified.migration_path_if_needed: Firestore → Cloud SQL (managed) → Self-hosted PostgreSQL (last resort)

key_takeaways.takeaway: Data transfer is the silent budget killer
key_takeaways.action: Monitor GCP egress costs monthly, keep agents and data in same region (us-west1)
Monitor Firestore costs monthly (threshold: $100 for review, $500 for action)
Implement API rate limiting with tiered limits, GitHub token rotation

key_takeaways.takeaway: Multi-cloud works for compute, fails for data
key_takeaways.action: Validate current single-cloud architecture is correct (it is)
Create disaster recovery runbook for common failure scenarios
